decisions.rationale: Run back the G1-winning structure: lead Sneasler + Incineroar, back Kingambit + Delphox. Their Sneasler's raw Speed cap is 172, so it cannot actually outspeed my 189 Sneasler — G1 it only moved first via Fake Out priority. That means at equal +3 priority my Quick Guard resolves BEFORE their Fake Out, so turn 1 Quick Guard blocks Fake Out side-wide, Intimidate drops their physical attackers, and Incineroar is free to Flare Blitz Froslass (or their Sneasler if Froslass Protects). This lead also beats Lycanroc+Froslass (Fake Out flinch + CC breaks Sash) and Froslass+Kingambit (CC 4x their Kingambit). The one bad matchup is a Basculegion lead since Incineroar lacks Protect; contingency is Fake Out Basculegion + Flare Blitz Froslass, then clean with Kingambit's Sucker Punch/Kowtow (73-168% range) and Delphox. Kingambit answers Froslass (Kowtow OHKO range), Sneasler (Sucker from 20%), and Basculegion; Delphox gives 171-Speed control with Psyshock 4x into Sneasler and Heat Wave into Froslass. Same four as the G1 win; re-evaluate for G3 only if they anti-lead successfully.
decisions.notebook: Confirmed calcs (G1): my LO Kingambit Sucker Punch KOs their Sneasler from >=20%; Kowtow Cleave vs Froslass-Mega through snow 75-141%, can OHKO from full (did so G1), guaranteed with any chip; Delphox Heat Wave + Kowtow = guaranteed Froslass KO; Froslass Shadow Ball KOs Delphox from <=29%; Froslass-Mega Thunderbolt ~27% to my Kingambit — Kingambit does not wall Froslass. Basculegion Wave Crash vs my Incineroar = guaranteed KO from 70% even at -1; Basculegion (98-130) always outspeeds Incineroar (88); -1 Aqua Jet vs Incineroar ~25-37% (Sitrus survives), KOs Delphox from ~30% — never Mega Delphox into a live Basculegion (priority ignores Mega's 204 Spe; Mega only to outspeed Froslass same-turn or for Levitate). My +0 LO Kingambit vs Basculegion: Sucker 73-137%, Kowtow 87-168%. Incineroar Throat Chop vs Basculegion 46-87%; Flare Blitz vs their Kingambit 63.8-75.4% (2HKO, recoil ~22-26%). Mirror chip: my LO Kowtow vs their Kingambit 16.4-28%, Sucker 13-24%. Their +1 LO Kowtow vs my Kingambit 27.5-39.6%; +1 Sucker does NOT KO my Kingambit from 31%; +1 Sucker vs Incineroar 22.4-32.8%. SPEED CORRECTION: their Sneasler's raw range is 140-172 — it CANNOT outspeed my 189 Sneasler; G1 it only moved first via Fake Out priority. Consequences: my Quick Guard (+3) resolves before their Fake Out (+3); my Sneasler out-speeds theirs with non-priority moves; their Sneasler max 172 also edges my 171 Delphox if fully invested. Froslass-Mega max 189 = potential speed TIE with my Sneasler. Their Kingambit Speed unknown (70-102) — assume it can beat my 71 and possibly Incineroar's 88. Opponent tendencies: standard opener Sneasler + Froslass, instant Mega Froslass; Kingambit in 2v1 endgames favors Protect/Sucker over Swords Dance, even clicks Sucker into the resisted mirror — double-target Kowtow + Flare Blitz every turn, prefer Kowtow chip (Sucker fails into SD/Protect); never let their Kingambit sit at +3 vs a lone weakened Incineroar; Parting Shot fails with no alive benched ally. G2 plan: same four, same lead, Quick Guard t1; if Froslass Protects t1, Flare Blitz their Sneasler instead. Watch for anti-leads: Basculegion lead (contingency: Fake Out Basculegion + Flare Blitz Froslass, trade Incineroar for Froslass, clean with Kingambit priority + Delphox; Kingambit tanks Wave Crash ~neutral if a pivot is needed), Lycanroc lead (Fake Out flinch + CC pops Sash; Lycanroc CC 4x threatens Kingambit — answer with Intimidate + Flare Blitz/Sucker), Scovillain-Mega (Overheat 2x vs Kingambit, Rage Powder redirects — Spicy Spray on Mega). My Kingambit at very low HP self-KOs to LO recoil — acceptable only as a Kowtow chip trade with healthy Incineroar behind. Delphox max-Speed Timid (171; Mega 204 beats max Froslass 189); Mega forfeits Blaze. If they adjust and win G2, consider swapping Delphox -> Sinistcha for G3 (immune to CC/Fake Out, Rage Powder shields Kingambit from Sneasler/Lycanroc CC, Trick Room for Kingambit, resists Basculegion's Water) or Blastoise (resists Basculegion's Water, Water Spout spread pressure).

decisions.rationale: Lead Kingambit and Sneasler to punish Incineroar’s Intimidate with Defiant, contest Fake Out, and retain immediate Fighting pressure into opposing Kingambit. Keep Mega Froslass for Snow Warning and late spread pressure, with Basculegion preserved as the priority-equipped endgame cleaner.
decisions.notebook: Mega Froslass is the preferred evolution for Snow Warning and spread pressure. Preserve Sneasler as the direct opposing-Kingambit answer, and avoid exposing Basculegion until opposing Kingambit is removed or Sucker Punch can be bypassed. Opponent may lead Sneasler plus Incineroar and use double Fake Out; they pivot Delphox away from Fighting pressure, may Protect it before Mega Evolution, and use Kingambit’s Sucker Punch aggressively. Allied Kingambit can exploit Incineroar’s Intimidate via Defiant. Opposing Incineroar is faster than allied Kingambit; its Flare Blitz deals 63.8-92.8%. Basculegion Aqua Jet guarantees Delphox from 29%; at -1 Attack, Wave Crash deals 37.7-64% to opposing Kingambit and 83.2-150.6% to Incineroar. Opposing Kingambit’s Sucker Punch deals 91.8-131.9% to Basculegion and 75.5-111% to Mega Froslass.

decisions.rationale: Double-target their Kingambit. My Sneasler's Close Combat is a guaranteed OHKO on it (139-240%), and Incineroar's Fake Out (+3) flinches their Kingambit through everything except Protect — beating Sucker Punch (+1) and preventing Kowtow Cleave/Swords Dance. This also keeps my Sneasler healthy: their Sneasler's lone Fake Out can only flinch one of my Pokémon, so if it flinches my Sneasler, Incineroar still flinches their Kingambit (no Kowtow chunk, my Sneasler stays ~75-85% and survives a single +1 Sucker to CC again on turn 2); if it flinches Incineroar or attacks, my Sneasler's CC OHKOs their Kingambit. Flinching their Kingambit protects my Sneasler (my Kingambit-answer) better than Quick Guard would, since Quick Guard doesn't stop Kowtow. Main risks: Kingambit Protect (especially paired with their Sneasler's CC into Incineroar, a likely OHKO) or a turn-1 switch to a Ghost (Froslass/Basculegion dodge both CC and Fake Out).

decisions.rationale: Their Sneasler's CC does ~87-103% of max HP to my Incineroar (more if Adamant), so from 89% Incineroar almost certainly dies before moving if targeted — I spend it as a trade piece rather than waste my Sneasler's turn on Quick Guard, which doesn't block CC and would lose Incineroar for nothing. reflections.summary: Won the game and closed the series 2-0. The game was effectively decided at team preview: my Kingambit + Mega Delphox core blanked everything they brought — King resists Froslass-Mega's entire kit and removes Basculegion with Kowtow, while Mega Delphox (204 Spe) outruns both Sneasler's base form and Froslass (189), 4x-Psyshocks Sneasler, and Heat Wave covers both. Their only real breaker, Defiant Kingambit, traded out turn 3 to Incineroar's Flare Blitz (crit-assisted), after which they had no path through the core; their remaining offense (Aqua Jet, resisted CCs, resisted Shadow Balls) only chipped. Variance favored me — the Flare Blitz crit, the Kowtow crit on Basc, the turn-8 Heat Wave burn on Froslass, and one successful consecutive Protect on Delphox — but the position was dominant regardless: even without the burn, Delphox outspeeds and KOs the 9% Froslass. My between-game role plan (King answers Basc/Froslass, Delphox answers Sneasler) worked exactly as designed, so the adjustment helped. Self-inflicted costs that didn't matter: I led Incineroar into their King and fed Defiant +2 again, my Sneasler lost the Adamant mirror (Focus Sash never triggered, taken out by SP chip + resisted CC), and I wasted three Sucker Punches into faster targets under this sim's SP rule before switching to Kowtow Cleave, which immediately produced the Basc KO.
reflections.adjustment: Keep the same four and Mega Delphox — the plan won at preview twice; the fixes are piloting, not construction. (1) Treat Sucker Punch as unclickable against anything faster (in this sim it fails outright); make Kowtow Cleave the default Dark STAB and reserve SP for slower 0-priority attackers only. (2) Stop letting Incineroar's Intimidate proc their Defiant King — switch it in only when their King isn't on the field, or only when Flare Blitz is immediately live to cash the trade. (3) Don't lead my Sneasler into theirs; their Adamant set wins the mirror after any chip and my sash is dead weight — lead Delphox into Sneasler (4x Psyshock, CC only ~46% back) and hold my Sneasler for late Fake Out/Quick Guard utility. (4) Keep the removal order: their King first, then Basc, then Froslass, with Delphox double-Protect stalls to let Kowtow work. Sinistcha-over-Sneasler (CC/Fake Out immune, Rage Powder shields King) remains the standing safety option, but a 2-0 says it isn't needed.
reflections.notebook: Sim rules: Sucker Punch FAILS vs faster targets — only usable vs slower 0-priority attackers; consecutive Protect ~1/3; Kowtow Cleave never misses. Speed ladder: Unburden Sneasler 280-344 > Mega Delphox 204 > Froslass max 189 > my King 71 — Delphox always moves before Froslass. Calcs: Psyshock 4x KOs Sneasler; Sneasler CC only ~46% vs Mega Delphox, but Sneasler CC + Froslass Shadow Ball on the same turn KOs Delphox even from full — never leave Delphox exposed to that double-up without Protect; Heat Wave->Froslass 62-116% and Kowtow->Froslass ~64% from full, so any HW chip makes Kowtow guaranteed; Froslass SB never OHKOs Mega Delphox from full; my King resists Froslass's entire kit and wins that 1v1 easily; snow Blizzard is only ~20% NVE chip. Opponent tendencies: double-targets the immediate/low-HP threat (e.g., Aqua Jet + coverage on the same slot); respects fresh Protects but fires into ones already burned; leans on priority + Protect to blunt Sucker Punch; their Adamant Sneasler wins the mirror vs my Jolly sash set once any chip lands; Mega Froslass sets snow and carries Thunderbolt for Water answers. Strategy: their Defiant King is the only breaker that threatens my core — never Intimidate it (free +2), remove it first via Flare Blitz/Kowtow; after that, King walls Froslass and beats Basculegion while Delphox owns Sneasler — protect those two roles and the matchup closes itself.

reflections.summary: The game was lost primarily because opposing Kingambit survived to control both Mega Froslass and Basculegion, while Mega Delphox used consecutive Protects to stall priority and then cleaned with Heat Wave. Critical hits that removed your boosted Kingambit and Basculegion materially worsened the position, and no piloting errors were recorded. The four brought were workable—Sneasler answered Kingambit, and Mega Froslass pressured Delphox—but they were overly dependent on preserving Sneasler and controlling Sucker Punch. Mega Froslass was a reasonable evolution choice, though it could not reliably KO Delphox and remained highly vulnerable to Kingambit. No game-1 evidence identifies a specific between-game change; whatever adjustment produced this game-2 plan failed to reverse the matchup, resulting in the 0-2 series loss.
reflections.adjustment: In a rematch, preserve Sneasler for opposing Kingambit rather than letting it become heavily weakened in the opening exchange. Prioritize removing or disabling Kingambit before exposing Mega Froslass or Basculegion, and avoid committing attacks into Delphox when Protect plus Kingambit pressure can punish them. The preview plan should reduce the team's shared Kingambit vulnerability; Mega Froslass remains viable only with a clearer Sucker Punch-control plan.
